short_division.note: div_rem_u256 divides by a divisor of one 64-bit limb (POS_SCALE, the bound scale, an ADL basis, a price) with schoolbook short division, four native 128-by-64 steps, instead of the bit-at-a-time loop of up to 192 rounds of compare, subtract and shift. Quotient and remainder are the same numbers; wider divisors take the old path.
